title: NASA Astrobiology Overview: The Search for Life Beyond Earth
excerpt: While NASA rovers continue to investigate biosignatures and past habitability on Mars, NASA has found no evidence of extraterrestrial life or alien civilizations on Mars.

title: Fact Check: NASA Did Not Announce Discovery of Alien Civilizations
excerpt: Claims circulating on social media stating NASA discovered underground cities on Mars are completely unfounded and misrepresent geological images taken by Mars rovers.

title: Oncology Guidance on Dietary Supplements and Cancer Treatment
excerpt: There are no peer-reviewed clinical trials or established medical guidelines supporting the claim that boiled garlic, lemon, or herbal concoctions eradicate cancer or replace standard oncological therapy.

title: Viral Post False Claiming Garlic Cures Cancer
excerpt: Medical experts interviewed by AP confirm that while garlic contains antioxidant compounds, claims that drinking garlic water cures cancer within 48 hours are dangerous medical disinformation.

title: PSLV-C57 / Aditya-L1 Mission Successfully Accomplished
excerpt: ISRO's Polar Satellite Launch Vehicle successfully placed India's maiden solar observatory Aditya-L1 into its intended elliptical orbit before progressing to Sun-Earth Lagrange point 1.

title: India Launches First Space Mission to Study the Sun
excerpt: India has launched its first mission to study the Sun, Aditya-L1, taking off from the Sriharikota launch pad just days after its historic Moon landing.

title: RBI Clarification: ₹500 Banknotes Continue as Legal Tender
excerpt: The Reserve Bank of India cautions the public against fake notifications claiming the withdrawal or demonetization of ₹500 denomination currency notes. These notes remain legal tender.

title: Announcement of the Death of Her Majesty Queen Elizabeth II
excerpt: Her Majesty Queen Elizabeth II died peacefully at Balmoral on 8 September 2022. The King and The Queen Consort remain at Balmoral this evening.

title: Annual Municipal Crime Trends and Statistical Baseline Report
excerpt: Specific category incidents moved from 1 reported incident in 2022 to 3 in 2023 across a district population of 150,000. While representing a 200% proportional change, absolute crime incidence remains among historic lows.

title: Local Energy Commission Preliminary Report on Grid Failure
excerpt: Initial findings suggested a cyber intrusion triggered automated substation breaker trip commands.

title: National Infrastructure Security Agency Debunks Cyberattack Rumor on Power Grid
excerpt: Comprehensive forensic analysis confirmed that the power grid outage was caused strictly by physical transmission line icing during severe freezing rain, with zero evidence of malicious cyber activity.
